  - Plot and chronology: a four-part OVA set 200 years after Final Fantasy V, in the same unnamed world (called Planet R in the OVA), where three of the four crystals have been stolen; the antagonist Ra Devil from the Black Moon, who becomes Deathgyunos, wants all the crystals; Prettz and Linaly, with the ghost Mid, the sky pirate Rouge and General Valkus of Tycoon, become the next Warriors of Light; agrees with the entry's description (200 years after V, Prettz and Linally against Deathgyunos); the entry spells the name Linally and the page Linaly; the ending is not in the description
  - **Episodes (the page's list, in order, on two VHS tapes with episodes 1 and 2 on the first and 3 and 4 on the second): Wind Chapter, Fire Chapter, Dragon Chapter, Star Chapter**; the entry has no `contents` parts for them (asked the user, see .plan/review-later.md)
  - Release and credits: released in 1994 in Japan and distributed on VHS in North America by Urban Vision in 1997, which has since lost the rights; directed by Rintaro with Naoto Kanda and Tomohiko Ohkuda, plot by Satoru Akahori, music by Masahiko Sato; consistent with the entry (1994-03-21, native; VHS and JP laserdisc rows, EN language); its Reception section collects mixed reviews (GameSpot, EX, Animefringe), a critical-content note outside our scope; its Links section names only https://www.square-enix.com/
